name: Crap Comment Nuker (ccn)
description: Interactive comment stripper that safely removes AI-generated comments, dead comments, TODOs, and Co-Authored-By spam from code across 9 languages (JS/TS/TSX, Python, Java, Kotlin, Rust, C, C++). Uses real parsers (Acorn for JS, tree-sitter for others) rather than regex. Primary safety feature: write gate re-parses files after modification and rejects any edit that would move even a single token, ensuring it cannot eat your code. Features color-coded comment categorization, simulurity clustering, --dry-run preview, and .bak backup creation.

name: Benzi

name: Ponytail
description: AI coding agent skill that prevents over-engineering by implementing a decision ladder forcing agents to evaluate options before writing code: (1) Does this need to exist? (2) Is it already in this repo? (3) Does standard library do it? (4) Does platform do it? (5) Does installed dependency do it? (6) Can it be one line? (7) Only then write minimum. Reports 54% less code generated, 20% cheaper to run, 27% faster execution, and up to 94% less code on tasks where agents typically over-build. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, and others via npm global install with commands like /ponytail [lite|full|ultra|off], /ponytail-review, /ponytail-audit, and /ponytail-debt.
community_quotes: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev
54% less code generated, 20% cheaper, 27% faster
Decision ladder before writing any code
The best code is the code you never wrote
